abstract: Today, I am delighted to announce that the SMPTE Motion Imaging Journal was recognized by the Society for Technical Communication (STC) as the winner of a Merit in the 2017 STC International Summit Awards competition! Congratulations to Glen Pensinger, along with the core editorial committee, the Board of Editors, contributing authors, and our managing editor, Dianne Purrier, for this recognition!
